description: Land Acquisition - Olaithoduvai, Mannar Town D/S Division, Mannar District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for taking possession of described land parcels, including detailed descriptions of the land locations, boundaries, and extents. While it mentions a government minister (Harin Fernando) issuing the orders, the core content focuses entirely on land acquisition procedures and property descriptions, making it a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
